description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) for a full-time opportunity in Orlando, FL. This role offers a highly competitive hourly rate of $47/hr, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent.

As an RN, you will play a crucial role in providing high-quality patient care, collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, and ensuring positive patient outcomes. This is an excellent chance to join a supportive environment where your skills and dedication will be valued.

We understand the importance of flexibility for our candidates. Interviews can be scheduled Monday through Friday from 1 PM to 7 PM, with additional availability over the weekend as needed, to accommodate your schedule.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Florida
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an RN
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
